visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide eye-level shot of two men standing on an elevated concourse at a baseball stadium. One man in a green t-shirt and khaki shorts holds a microphone and points towards the vast rows of empty green stadium seats. The sky is bright and clear. (2) The camera pans across a pillar decorated with colorful square ceramic tiles featuring various drawings, including baseball gloves and American flags. The background reveals the stadium's field and several tall modern buildings in the distance under daylight. (3) Inside a room with grey brick walls, a young woman with a long dark ponytail, wearing a pinstriped baseball jersey and a white pleated skirt, observes several framed jerseys mounted on the wall. The lighting is bright and indoor. (4) Transition to a concession area where a male employee in a black t-shirt hands two white pizza boxes to a woman with reddish hair. Colorful confetti graphics and various digital text overlays float on the screen. (5) A close-up shot captures a woman taking a large bite of a golden-brown battered corndog. As she pulls it away, a long, thick strand of melted white cheese stretches from the food to her mouth. (6) Two women walk outdoors at night near a stadium gate with a large sign that reads "ATHLETICS." They wear red bows in their hair and smile at the camera as people pass by in the background. (7) Footage shifts to a night baseball game where a player in a blue uniform with "17" on the back (Shohei Ohtani) bats and then runs towards first base on a lush green field. (8) A large electronic scoreboard at night displays the text "RAISE THE JOLLY ROGER" alongside live footage. (9) The final scene shows the main woman holding a plastic bag containing two white baseballs while her friend behind her holds a larger bag full of them. They are laughing in a brightly lit outdoor hallway.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice greeting the audience over an upbeat electronic pop track with a bright synth melody at 124 BPM. The voice exhibits high pitch variability and a friendly, animated tone. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates a scene change, followed by the sound of background crowd chatter in a large open space. (3) A brief male voice with a calm, neutral tone says 'I like pizza,' which is immediately followed by the female narrator's higher-pitched exclamation. A digital 'pop' SFX accompanies the visual appearance of confetti. (4) A 'ding' SFX signals a close-up on food, with faint foley of chewing heard underneath the BGM. The music maintains a constant, driving rhythm. (5) The acoustic atmosphere shifts to an outdoor night setting with muffled street noise and multiple female voices laughing together. (6) A sharp transient impact of a baseball bat hitting a ball is heard, followed by a surge in high-arousal cheering and stadium applause. (7) The narrator returns to center focus with clear, enunciated Mandarin speech, while the BGM continues its rhythmic pulse. (8) The track concludes with a final 'sparkle' SFX as multiple voices giggle, fading into the ambient room tone of the recording.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Arrival -> Observation -> Consumption -> Main Event -> Outcome
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a day-to-night trip to an American Major League Baseball stadium, highlighting the scale of the facility, the local food, the presence of star players like Shohei Ohtani, and the fun of purchasing merchandise.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While brands and specific locations are visible, the content is framed as a personal travel vlog and fan experience without a clear promotional call to action.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses fast-paced editing and variety-show style text to maintain high energy, effectively blending lifestyle, food, and sports content.
